headline: Am I being misled?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

On the two Magician/Hanged Man/Fool decks — one set of copy, verb swapped.

⚠️ TRUST IS A SEED FAMILY WITH NO GUARD FILE (`tests/tarot-trust-copy.test.ts` does not exist). Only the generic guards apply, so this is among the least protected copy on the funnel and the bans below come from TAROT_HOOK_TENDENCY rather than from a test.

Finding: the MISMATCH between what she has been told and what she has observed is real information, and the confusion is not a flaw in her judgment. 🔴 Never state he is deceiving her, and 🔴 never tell her she is imagining it — both are available and both are wrong. What gets affirmed is her perception and her right to trust her own eyes.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — the four things on his table don't match each other.
You asked if you're being misled. Your hand went to the man who arranges things.
So two things you were given don't fit, dear. You saw that yourself.
And there on his table, four things, and no two of them alike.
But a mismatch tells you nothing about why, dear. Only that it's there.
That's why you keep going back over what he said, lining it up.
Let me look closer at what stands between you and a story that fits…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — from where you stand, his face is where his feet should be.
You asked if you're being misled. Your hand went to the card that flips a view.
So the muddle is in the picture, dear. It isn't in you.
And you've been handed this the wrong way up, dear.
But nobody has turned it round for you, dear. You've had to do it.
That's why working it out takes you hours. It arrives upside down, dear.
Let me look closer at what has been turning this around on you…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — the rocks he stands on are cut in flat layers.
You asked if you're being misled. Your hand went to the one who doesn't check his footing.
So you've been asked to walk without checking, dear. That's what feels wrong.
And he's one step from a drop, dear, and looking the other way.
But this card names nothing about what sits under it, dear.
That's why checking felt like doubt to you. Checking is just looking, dear.
Let me look closer at what has been hidden under this…
